import os,sys,tempfile,unittest,time
sys.path[:0]=[os.getcwd(),os.path.join(os.getcwd(),'tests')]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='sentinel-phase03-tests-') as td:
 os.environ['SENTINELSCAN_DATA_DIR']=td;os.environ['SENTINELSCAN_LLM_ENABLED']='false'
 suite=unittest.TestSuite()
 for pattern in ('test_website_scanner.py','test_finding_context.py'):
  suite.addTests(unittest.defaultTestLoader.discover('tests',pattern=pattern))
 for name in ('test_hardening.HardeningTests.test_malformed_nmap_falls_back_without_shell','test_hardening.HardeningTests.test_dast_persistence_masks_credentials_and_form_errors','test_network_reliability.NetworkReliabilityTests.test_browser_fragment_is_not_sent_or_persisted'):
  suite.addTests(unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromName(name))
 result=unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite)
 sys.exit(not result.wasSuccessful())
